text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Dart SDK
      uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
      with:
        sdk: 'stable'
        architecture: 'x64'

    - name: Set up Flutter SDK
      run: |
        wget https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.0.5-stable.tar.xz
        tar xf flutter_linux_3.0.5-stable.tar.xz
        export PATH="$PWD/flutter/bin:$PATH"

    - name: Run dart pub get
      run: dart pub get

    - name: Configure Dart workspace
      run: |
        echo "workspace:" > pubspec.yaml
        find . -name "pubspec.yaml" ! -path "./pubspec.yaml" | while read -r file; do
          sed -i.bak '/^environment:/d' "$file"
          echo "  resolution: workspace" >> "$file"
        done
```

This GitHub Actions workflow sets up the Copilot environment with Dart and Flutter SDKs, runs `dart pub get` to resolve dependencies, and configures a Dart workspace for the monorepo.
